IRS990.MissionDesc: THE ALIGNMENT RESEARCH CENTER IS A NON PROFIT RESEARCH ORGANIZATION WHOSE MISSION IS TO ALIGN FUTURE MACHINE LEARNING SYSTEMS WITH HUMAN INTERESTS.
IRS990.Desc: THE THEORY TEAM ACHIEVED SEVERAL SIGNIFICANT MILESTONES INCLUDING (I) PUBLISHING THE FIRST EMPIRICAL PAPER ON LOW PROBABILITY ESTIMATION IN LANGUAGE MODELS, ALONGSIDE ADDITIONAL PUBLICATIONS ON BACKDOOR DEFENSE, LEARNABILITY AND OBFUSCATION, AND HEURISTIC ESTIMATION METHODOLOGIES, (II) RELEASING A UNIFIED RESEARCH VISION DOCUMENT ARTICULATING THE THEORETICAL FRAMEWORK UNDERLYING THE TEAM'S RESEARCH PROGRAM, AND (III) EXPANDING RESEARCH CAPACITY BY HIRING THREE FULL-TIME RESEARCHERS AND HOSTING APPROXIMATELY EIGHT VISITING RESEARCHERS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: EVALUATIONS (DISCONTINUED): PRIOR TO COMPLETING THE SPIN OUT IN MAY, THE EVALUATIONS TEAM HAD A NUMBER OF ACHIEVEMENTS INCLUDING (I) DEVELOPING AND PUBLISHING A SUITE OF RESOURCES AND METHODOLOGIES FOR CONDUCTING EVALUATIONS OF AI SYSTEM AUTONOMY, (II) EXPANDING THE ENGINEERING TEAM LEADING TO THE PUBLICATION OF AN OPEN-SOURCE SOFTWARE PLATFORM FOR CONDUCTING AUTONOMY EVALUATIONS, (III) SUPPORTING THE DEVELOPMENT OF INDUSTRY-STANDARD RISK MANAGEMENT POLICIES AT MULTIPLE ORGANIZATIONS INCLUDING ANTHROPIC AND GOOGLE DEEPMIND.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: AS A TAX EXEMPT NONPROFIT ORGANIZATION, THE ORGANIZATION IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAX UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AND FROM STATE FRANCHISE TAX UNDER CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE SECTION 23701(D), BUT IS SUBJECT TO TAXES ON UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME WHEN EARNED. NO UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME WAS EARNED FOR THE YEARS ENDED DECEMBER 31, 2024. THE ORGANIZATION HAS ADOPTED THE ACCOUNTING STANDARD RELATED TO UNCERTAINTIES IN INCOME TAXES. THE ORGANIZATION EVALUATES UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS THROUGH ITS REVIEW OF THE SOURCE OF REVENUE TO IDENTIFY UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME AND CERTAIN OTHER MATTERS, INCLUDING THOSE WHICH MAY AFFECT ITS TAX EXEMPT STATUS. MANAGEMENT BELIEVES THEIR ESTIMATES RELATED TO INCOME TAX UNCERTAINTIES ARE APPROPRIATE BASED ON THE CURRENT FACTS AND CIRCUMSTANCES. THE ORGANIZATION'S FEDERAL RETURN OF ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAX (FORM 990) ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY THE TAX JURISDICTION BACK TO 2022. THE STATE RETURNS (FORM 199) FILED SINCE THE ORGANIZATION'S INCEPTION IN 2021 ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY STATE TAX AGENCIES.
